evidence: Plaut. Cas. 222: neque salsum neque suāve esse potest quicquam, ubi amor nōn admiscētur
terms.comment: The participle of saliō, to salt. Of talk it means witty, as sāl means wit.

phrases.latin: Hoc salsum est; hoc adustum est; hoc lautum est parum; illud rēctē: iterum sīc mementō.
phrases.english: This is too salty; this is burnt; this isn’t washed enough; that one is right: remember to do it so again.

phrases.latin: Gustās. Sī fatuum fuerit, liquāmen adjiciēs, sī salsum, mellis modicum …
phrases.english: Taste it. If it’s bland, add fish sauce; if it’s salty, a little honey …

phrases.latin: Nimis salsum est; paulum aquae adde.
phrases.english: It’s too salty; add a little water.

sources: Lewis & Short: salio
